sourceEvidence: CanvasView.clipChanged在isRelayingOut=true时直接return，结束时没有核对layout.viewportSize与contentView.bounds.size。

diagnosis.proposal: 重排内在设置内容尺寸后确认最终clip几何，若滚动条改变视口则以同一锚点重新计算布局；保持原自检等待和精确frame断言。

import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import select
import signal
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
label = os.environ.get('MV_DIAG_LABEL', 'probe')
case = WORK / label
case.mkdir()
for name in ('support', 'cache', 'tmp'):
    (case / name).mkdir()
binary = ROOT / 'build/DerivedData-profile/Build/Products/Debug/MacView.app/Contents/MacOS/MacView'
log = case / 'app.log'
socket = ROOT / 'build' / f'vld-{os.getpid()}.sock'
command = ['open', '-n', '-a', str(binary.parents[2]), '--stdout', str(log), '--stderr', str(log),
           '--env', f'TMPDIR={case / "tmp"}/', '--args', '-MVViewerSelfTest', 'YES',
           '-MVSelfTestFixtures', str(ROOT / 'Fixtures'), '-MVSupportDirectory', str(case / 'support'),
           '-MVCacheDirectory', str(case / 'cache'), '-MVLayoutFile', str(case / 'layout.json'),
           '-MVDebugSocket', str(socket)]
started = time.monotonic()
record = {'label': label, 'startedAt': datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),
          'command': command, 'binarySHA256': hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          'signature': subprocess.run(['codesign', '-d', '--verbose=4', str(binary.parents[2])], capture_output=True, text=True).stderr,
          'sourceSHA256': hashlib.sha256((ROOT / 'App/Debug/ViewerSelfTest.swift').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
record['openExitCode'] = subprocess.run(command).returncode
pid = None
for _ in range(200):
    lines = subprocess.check_output(['ps', '-axo', 'pid=,command='], text=True).splitlines()
    matched = [int(line.split(None, 1)[0]) for line in lines if line.split(None, 1)[1].startswith(str(binary) + ' ')
               and ('-MVDebugSocket ' + str(socket)) in line]
    if matched:
        assert len(matched) == 1
        pid = matched[0]
        break
    time.sleep(.05)
assert pid is not None
record['pid'] = pid
print(json.dumps({'pid': pid, 'label': label, 'runnerPID': os.getpid()}), flush=True)
watch = select.kqueue()
watch.control([select.kevent(pid, filter=select.KQ_FILTER_PROC, flags=select.KQ_EV_ADD | select.KQ_EV_ONESHOT,
                            fflags=select.KQ_NOTE_EXIT | 0x04000000)], 0)
events = []
while time.monotonic() - started < 180:
    events = watch.control([], 1, 1)
    if events:
        break
if not events:
    os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM)
    events = watch.control([], 1, 5)
    record['timedOut'] = True
if not events:
    os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
    events = watch.control([], 1, 5)
record['realExitObserved'] = bool(events)
record['exitCode'] = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(events[0].data) if events else None
record['durationSeconds'] = time.monotonic() - started
watch.close()
record['rawLog'] = log.read_text(errors='replace') if log.exists() else ''
record['probes'] = [json.loads(line.split(' ', 1)[1]) for line in record['rawLog'].splitlines() if line.startswith('LAYOUT_PROBE ')]
record['passes'] = len(re.findall(r'^PASS ', record['rawLog'], re.M))
record['failures'] = re.findall(r'^FAIL .+', record['rawLog'], re.M)
(case / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
socket.unlink(missing_ok=True)
print(json.dumps({k: record[k] for k in ('pid', 'exitCode', 'durationSeconds', 'passes', 'failures')}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)

+                "placed": canvas.placedCount, "ratios": canvas.items.map { $0.aspectRatio ?? -1 },

+                "loadedImages": canvas.counters.loadedImages, "inFlight": canvas.counters.inFlight,
+            ]
+            let data = try! JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: values, options: [.sortedKeys])
+            print("LAYOUT_PROBE " + String(decoding: data, as: UTF8.self))
+        }
+        let previousMeasure = canvas.onMeasure
+        let previousImageApplied = canvas.onImageApplied
+        canvas.onMeasure = { measure in
+            previousMeasure?(measure)
+            if case .relayout = measure { probe("relayout") }
+        }
+        canvas.onImageApplied = {
+            previousImageApplied?()
+            probe("imageApplied")
+        }
+        probe("before")
         let frames = (0..<40).map { canvas.frame(of: $0) }

import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import select
import signal
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
label = 'boundary'
case = WORK / label
case.mkdir()
for name in ('support', 'cache', 'tmp'):
    (case / name).mkdir()
binary = ROOT / 'build/DerivedData-profile/Build/Products/Debug/MacView.app/Contents/MacOS/MacView'
log = case / 'app.log'
socket = ROOT / 'build' / f'vld-{os.getpid()}.sock'
command = ['open', '-n', '-a', str(binary.parents[2]), '--stdout', str(log), '--stderr', str(log),
           '--env', f'TMPDIR={case / "tmp"}/', '--args', '-MVViewerSelfTest', 'YES', '-MVLayoutBoundaryCheck', 'YES',
           '-MVSelfTestFixtures', str(ROOT / 'Fixtures'), '-MVSupportDirectory', str(case / 'support'),
           '-MVCacheDirectory', str(case / 'cache'), '-MVLayoutFile', str(case / 'layout.json'),
           '-MVDebugSocket', str(socket)]
started = time.monotonic()
record = {'label': label, 'startedAt': datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),
          'command': command, 'binarySHA256': hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          'signature': subprocess.run(['codesign', '-d', '--verbose=4', str(binary.parents[2])], capture_output=True, text=True).stderr,
          'sourceSHA256': hashlib.sha256((ROOT / 'App/Debug/ViewerSelfTest.swift').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
record['openExitCode'] = subprocess.run(command).returncode
pid = None
for _ in range(200):
    lines = subprocess.check_output(['ps', '-axo', 'pid=,command='], text=True).splitlines()
    matched = [int(line.split(None, 1)[0]) for line in lines if line.split(None, 1)[1].startswith(str(binary) + ' ')
               and ('-MVDebugSocket ' + str(socket)) in line]
    if matched:
        assert len(matched) == 1
        pid = matched[0]
        break
    time.sleep(.05)
assert pid is not None
record['pid'] = pid
print(json.dumps({'pid': pid, 'label': label, 'runnerPID': os.getpid()}), flush=True)
watch = select.kqueue()
watch.control([select.kevent(pid, filter=select.KQ_FILTER_PROC, flags=select.KQ_EV_ADD | select.KQ_EV_ONESHOT,
                            fflags=select.KQ_NOTE_EXIT | 0x04000000)], 0)
events = []
sampled = False
while time.monotonic() - started < 12:
    events = watch.control([], 1, 1)
    if not events and time.monotonic() - started >= 3 and not sampled:
        sample = subprocess.run(['sample', str(pid), '1', '1', '-file', str(case / 'hang.sample.txt')], capture_output=True, text=True)
        record['sampleDiagnostic'] = sample.stdout + sample.stderr
        sampled = True
    if events:
        break
if not events:
    os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM)
    events = watch.control([], 1, 5)
    record['timedOut'] = True
if not events:
    os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
    events = watch.control([], 1, 5)
record['realExitObserved'] = bool(events)
record['exitCode'] = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(events[0].data) if events else None
record['durationSeconds'] = time.monotonic() - started
watch.close()
record['rawLog'] = log.read_text(errors='replace') if log.exists() else ''
record['boundaries'] = [json.loads(line.split(' ', 1)[1]) for line in record['rawLog'].splitlines() if line.startswith('LAYOUT_BOUNDARY ')]
record['convergencePasses'] = [json.loads(line.split(' ', 1)[1]) for line in record['rawLog'].splitlines() if line.startswith('CONVERGENCE_PASS ')]
if (case / 'hang.sample.txt').exists(): record['rawSample'] = (case / 'hang.sample.txt').read_text(errors='replace')
record['passes'] = len(re.findall(r'^PASS ', record['rawLog'], re.M))
record['failures'] = re.findall(r'^FAIL .+', record['rawLog'], re.M)
(case / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
socket.unlink(missing_ok=True)
print(json.dumps({k: record[k] for k in ('pid', 'exitCode', 'durationSeconds', 'passes', 'failures')}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
